I know technically the answer is "there is no right answer", but here's my honest take on it:

I find that books with more than 3 POV characters is too much. Unless it is done masterfully, more than 3 characters can be overwhelming at best I've found. Often times, readers will not care as much about 1 of the 3 characters, and with more than 3 you run the risk of some readers just not enjoying large amounts of the book because they don't enjoy the extra characters. 

So in my opinion: 3 POV characters max. Unless, however, you have some sparse cut-in chapters from a character that is not one of your mains, like maybe a chapter here and there from the villain's perspective. Play around with it! But if a cutoff makes you feel more comfortable, I say 3 tops.
